verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs say its AI learns your voice and style from emails you send so drafts sound like you. The assistant can write drafts, and triggers can draft replies automatically when emails arrive, leaving them for you to review and send. Ghostwriter autocomplete is also described as based on your previous emails. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of voice fidelity, in-depth documentation of how voice/style learning works or can be tuned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
